scope: Native mapper only, same 14 original raw inputs/cached labels and fixed thresholds; no detector, planner, ROS or runtime changes. Old-mount mode is historical reprojection, not real old-mount data. Source attribution includes all baseline occupied cells that became nonoccupied. Pixel examples are sampled; raw full resolution center coordinates are approximate.
limits: Floor candidate is sensor-internal consistency, not independent physical truth; cross-epoch replay assumes the same base-relative floor height and old mount.
Original occupied measurements are preserved; transition counts do not certify free space.
No scientific or physical success is inferred from changed cells.
